name: Vertiv
description: Vertiv makes the power and cooling equipment that keeps data centres (and telecom and industrial sites) running: uninterruptible power supplies, switchgear, busbar, rack power, air and liquid cooling, racks and enclosures, plus software and a global service network. Demand is driven by data-centre construction, increasingly for AI compute; backlog was $15.0 billion at 2025-12-31 (2024: $7.2 billion) with most expected to ship in 12 to 18 months. It is reported by region: Americas (62 percent of sales), Asia Pacific and EMEA. About 80 percent of sales are products (equipment sold once per build-out) and 20 percent services and spares (maintenance, parts, field service) that recur on the installed base.

employees.note: Approximately 34,000 full- and part-time employees, about 41 percent in manufacturing.

businessLines.name: Americas
businessLines.how: Sells data-centre power (UPS, switchgear, busbar), thermal management (air and liquid cooling), racks and integrated modular solutions to hyperscale, colocation and enterprise data-centre builders, largely per project with long lead times and backlog; services and spares $1,116.2M recur.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment operating profit (before corporate costs; total of three segments computed as $2,313.8M)

businessLines.name: Asia Pacific
businessLines.how: Sells the same power and cooling equipment and services to data-centre and telecom customers in Asia Pacific; lower margin mix.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment operating profit (before corporate costs; total of three segments computed as $2,313.8M)

businessLines.name: Europe, Middle East & Africa
businessLines.how: Sells power, thermal and integrated infrastructure and services to data-centre, telecom and industrial customers in EMEA.

operatingProfit.period: FY2025 (year ended 2025-12-31), segment operating profit (before corporate costs; total of three segments computed as $2,313.8M)

brands.name: Liebert (heritage data-centre power and cooling brand)
brands.note: Mentioned as the origin of the business; revenue by brand not disclosed

brands.name: Great Lakes Data Racks & Cabinets
brands.note: Acquired August 2025 for about $200 million; racks, cabinets and integrated white-space infrastructure; revenue not broken out.
